coverage.meaning: Definition coverage is not a champion-lore certification. The deep review read the full and short biography fields and the live profile introduction of all eighteen champions, and what stays outside that coverage is skins, map appearances, other media and the in-world dates. All specialties and ordinary coavailability are command-game adaptations; no hero is a targetable champion creature.

nativeRoutes.availability: vcmi-develop/vcmi-develop/config/schemas/hero.json:24-27: special:true excludes starting selection and normal taverns; placement/unlocking needs separately authored maps.
nativeRoutes.specialtyShortcuts: vcmi-develop/vcmi-develop/lib/entities/hero/CHeroHandler.cpp:142-223,268-323: upgrade-aware creature, secondary, scaling-spell and explicit per-target-tier fixed-enchant shortcuts.
nativeRoutes.fixedEnchant: vcmi-develop/vcmi-develop/scripts/spells/timed.lua:34-57: explicit tier-vector entry is added once to the buffered spell bonus, not multiplied by the target's tier.
nativeRoutes.spellScaling: vcmi-develop/vcmi-develop/lib/mapObjects/CGHeroInstance.cpp:890-923: 5 * floor(heroLevel / max(targetTier,1)) percentage specialty modifier, with native arithmetic/rounding.
nativeRoutes.physicalReduction: vcmi-develop/vcmi-develop/scripts/damage/damageCalculator.lua:301-308: damageTypeAll non-spell-effect GENERAL_DAMAGE_REDUCTION enters the physical Armorer factor, not magical spell damage protection.
nativeRoutes.defenseReduction: vcmi-develop/vcmi-develop/scripts/damage/damageCalculator.lua:182-189: positive reduction r ignores min(floor(r * targetDefense / 100) + 1, targetDefense), under native attack-mode filtering; not a flat 10 Defense.
nativeRoutes.catapult: vcmi-develop/vcmi-develop/lib/battle/actions/CatapultAction.cpp:84-92: CATAPULT_EXTRA_SHOTS is read from a unit that carries a CATAPULT ability with a matching subtype and supplies the catapult spell shot level; value3 is mastery, not three free creature attacks. The native siege catapult war machine (config/creatures/special.json) carries subtype catapultShot and the native Ballistics skill grants the same subtype, so the bonus is reachable in a siege. Zaun does not use it: the roster already gives Ziggs native Ballistics, and the catalogue keeps the siege line distinct from the other Zaun specialties.
nativeRoutes.boundary: Read-only source inspection, not executed engine behavior. Installed runtime/version parity, additive interactions, exclusions, AI and serialization still need matching tests.
nativeRoutes.siegeWallPenalty: vcmi-develop/vcmi-develop/lib/battle/CBattleInfoCallback.cpp:278-293: the NO_WALL_PENALTY bonus is read on the shooter and removes the wall penalty for that shot; scripts/damage/damageCalculator.lua:332 applies the -0.5 factor to a shot that passes through fortifications. The bonus does not let a shooter attack walls.

zaunMachinist.meaning: Shared practical might/command rules, not a canonical guild, citizenship certificate or proof that Mundo and Urgot are trained engineers.

zaunChemist.meaning: Shared technical/support rules; Janna is not thereby an industrial chemist and Heimerdinger does not become a Zaun citizen.

classDecisions.skills: Every hero has two Basic registered starting skills. Eight explicit weighted class entries are not an eight-skill whitelist; omitted skills may inherit native affinity defaults. Skill weights are not percentages.
classDecisions.commanderCompatibility: Both classes reference own chemtechConstruct in the schema's commander field. This is compatibility data, not authorization or evidence for a new commander subsystem, free construct or extra recruit line.
classDecisions.art: Own class battle/map and hero portrait/specialty resource paths are authored references only; missing final assets and native rendering are not accepted.

startingArmies.meaning: Only low-tier own-faction starting stacks. Individual ranges in content/heroes.json are balance configuration, not canonical entourages.
startingArmies.scenarioBoundary: A scenario must place/replace armies and explain purpose, consent, opposition or protective containment. Generic defaults do not make Warwick, Janna, Piltover guests and local protectors willing baron soldiers.
startingArmies.accessBoundary: No map placement, eight-active-hero handling, prison release or sequential-access behavior is accepted by this ledger.

availability.setup: Inspect new-game starts and repeated ordinary tavern refreshes in Zaun and original towns, then separately placed scenario guests.
assertions: Exactly six ordinary eligible hero definitions; twelve special:true heroes excluded from normal starts/taverns.
Original heroes/factions remain unchanged; portrait/class resources resolve.
Scenario access, eight-active-hero limit and save/reload retain explicit availability.

physicalReduction.setup: Equal-primary-stat/equal-Armorer specialist and control, physical melee/ranged attacks plus magical spell control.
assertions: Native physical reduction factor has five additional percentage points; final rounded damage follows ordinary modifiers.
Magical spell damage/control gains no protection; army splitting does not multiply the specialty.

secondary.setup: Matched Armorer/Archery mastery at hero levels1,5,10 and no-relevant-skill control.
assertions: Step5 scales that skill's existing effect, not five flat percentage points per level.
Ineligible damage category, unrelated statistics and kill counts do not gain the specialty.
Save/reload and AI turns do not accumulate a permanent bonus.

fixedSpell.setup: Matched mastery/Spell Power specialist/control casts on tier1 and tier7, then recast, expiry and Dispel.
assertions: Haste is exactly one Speed stronger; Stone Skin exactly two Defense stronger at every listed tier.
Ordinary action, mana, mastery, duration, target eligibility and removal remain.
No permanent upgrade, extra action or cumulative recast benefit.

attackMode.setup: Matched hero/army with ranged and melee attacks against target Defense0,1,10,20.
assertions: Fixed Attack2 or percentage Defense10 reduction applies only to its configured attack mode and creatures.
Defense penetration follows the native floor-plus-one capped formula, not flat10Defense or universal damage.
Hero primaries, ammunition, retaliation eligibility and other attack mode remain unchanged.

siegeWallPenalty.setup: Siege battle against a defended town with walls, one hero army holding the specialty and one control army without it, using the same ranged stack on the same wall hex.
assertions: The specialised army's shots at defenders behind the walls keep full damage; the control army loses the native wall factor.
Melee attacks, siege engines, adventure buildings and shots outside a town siege are unchanged for both armies.

morale.setup: Battle and adventure rounds with a hero army holding the morale specialty and a control army with the same stat line but no specialty.
assertions: The specialised army draws one additional morale point, within the native morale cap and the native double-morale draw.
No other statistic changes and the bonus does not resurrect or cure creatures.

luck.setup: Repeated battles with a hero army holding the Luck specialty and a control army with the same stat line.
assertions: The specialised army draws one additional luck point, within the native luck cap.
The draw distribution is the native one and no other statistic changes.

sightRadius.setup: Adventure map with hidden objects at the edge of the hero's vision, comparing the specialised hero with a control hero of the same stat line.
assertions: The specialised hero reveals one additional hex of adventure map sight.
Battlefield Speed, troop movement and per-target permanent Speed are unchanged.
